# Individual Plots

```{r auditory_plot}
auditory_long <- auditory |>
  filter(Status=="Longitudinal") |>
   mutate(
    `Age (wks)` = as.numeric(`Age (wks)`),
    `Proportion Correct` = as.numeric(`Proportion Correct`),
     `experience` = as.numeric(`# Prior Test Sessions`)
  )

auditory_plot <- auditory_long|>
  ggplot(aes(x=`Age (wks)`, y = `Proportion Correct`))+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.2, width = 0.05, height = 0.05)+
  geom_smooth(method="loess", color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(8, 20), 
    breaks = seq(8, 20, by = 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1), 
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels = as.character
  ) +
  labs(title = "Auditory Discrimination")
```

# Figure 2

```{r Fig2, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 12}
(marker_plot   | workingmem_plot | distraction_plot) /
(auditory_plot | odor_plot       | detour_plot)      /
(reversal_plot | looktime_plot   | proplooked_plot)  /
(causal_plot   | momentary_plot  | plot_spacer())& 
  theme_grey(base_family = "serif") + #match theme to original
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.line  = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black")
  )

```

# Per-Task Models

```{r models}
task_models <- function(df2) {
  df2 <- df2 |>
  mutate(experience = `# Prior Test Sessions`)
  
m_age  <- glmer(cbind(`Proportion Correct`) ~ `Age (wks)` + (1 | `Dog ID`),
                  family = binomial, data = df2 )
m_exp  <- glmer(cbind(`Proportion Correct`) ~ `Age (wks)` + experience + (1 | `Dog ID`),
                  family = binomial, data = df2 ) 

tibble(AIC_age = AIC(m_age), AIC_age_exp = AIC(m_exp))
  }

bind_rows(
  "Marker gesture"               = task_models(marker),
  "Working memory (Delay)"       = task_models(workingmem),
  "Working memory (Distraction)" = task_models(distraction),
  "Auditory discrimination"      = task_models(auditory),
  "Odor discrimination"         = task_models(odor),
  "Cylinder: inhibitory control" = task_models(detour),
  "Cylinder: reversal learning"  = task_models(reversal),
  "Causal reasoning"             = task_models(causal),
  "Momentary pointing"           = task_models(momentary),
.id="Task") |>
  mutate(Best = if_else(AIC_age_exp < AIC_age, "age + experience", "age"))

```

`correct ~ age + (1 | puppy_ID)` is better for Marker gesture and Momentary pointing

`correct ~ age + experience + (1 | puppy_ID)` is better for both working memory tasks (delay and distraction), both sensory discrimination tasks (auditory and odor), both cylinder tasks (detour and reversal), and causal reasoning
